fieldData.awb---integration-feature-1:
The nurse sees every inhaler before the bus leaves

Westbrook High's band takes 2 buses to the state festival and stays overnight. The slip asks for an emergency contact and every medicine a student will carry. Each student signs a line under the parent's signature. The night before, the trip nurse gets the 5 students with medication, sorted by bus.
fieldData.awb---mockup-data: window.awbMockup = { elementaryClasses: "I teach Grade 3 and need a field trip permission slip for our aquarium trip. Parents should sign on their phones. Show me a dashboard with signed and missing slips for my 26 students, and two days before the trip, email every family that has not signed with a link to their child's slip.", highSchoolTrips: "My high school band is taking 2 buses to an overnight festival. Build a permission slip that asks for an emergency contact and every medicine each student will carry, with a line the student signs under the parent. The night before we leave, send our trip nurse a list of students with medication, sorted by bus.", spanishSpeakingFamilies: "Nine of the 24 families in my class read Spanish first. Build a field trip slip that opens in English or Spanish, with the same questions and signature line in both. Save both versions to the same columns and give me a single list of every family with a column showing which language they used.", childCareCenters: "My child care center takes the van to the public library every Thursday. Build a trip permission slip parents sign once for the season. Before the van leaves, show the director a roster built from the signed slips, and flag any child without a signature so a staff member stays back with them." };
fieldData.afb---prompt: Build a field trip permission slip for my class.

acrm---key-feature-2-image.alt: A Westbrook High band medication list sorted by bus goes to the trip nurse the night before an overnight festival trip, covering the 5 students who carry medicine.
